title: Age of Consent
summary: The age of consent is the minimum age at which the law considers someone able to agree to sex. It differs by country; in India it is 18 for everyone under current law.
key_points: Below that age, consent isn't legally valid regardless of what anyone says.
Laws can change; for legal questions check current official sources.
answer_guidance: Give the general concept; for a specific country's current law, suggest checking official/current sources.
